targeting_gate.rationale: Explicit catchment placement/priority model; five service-demand indicators route outside structural T4. Organic-soil former-wetland proxy retained separately.

key_findings: Explicit catchment placement/priority model; five service-demand indicators route outside structural T4. Organic-soil former-wetland proxy retained separately.
Independent review retained source-specific candidate groups; see inventory candidate_group_id and independent_review.md. No admissions.
holds: Priority scores must not become establishment curves.
Organic soils are proxy for former waterlogging, not proof all organic soils or only organic soils qualify.
Candidate groups require separate identity, canonical variable and family review; no universal threshold or forced ontology mapping.
candidate_count_basis: Provisional candidate passage/model-component groups; not EvidenceUnit or admitted-row counts.
completion_boundary: Source-purpose screening and documented passages only; no claim of complete main-paper/supplement extraction, source sweep, human approval or executable mapping.
